_comment: Sprite-only marker graphics. The sprite key is "marker-" + the object key; the prefix is owned by markerSpriteKey() in packages/core, never written here. Ids describe shape and colour, never use-case — no marker is tied to a catalogue symbol or line type. Markers have no BABS id, no de/fr/it label and no parent symbol, and never reach babs-react or babs-assets. Loader + recolour: packages/pipeline/src/markers.ts.

chevron-blue.note: Single chevron. Line-endpoint cap, consumed with icon-rotate.

chevron-red.note: Geometry shared with chevron-blue. Sprites are not SDF, so icon-color cannot recolour at runtime — colour variants must be baked.

double-chevron-blue.note: Double chevron. Reads as a heavier weight than chevron-blue.
